title: Economics as a Meeting Place: Research, Collaboration, and Student Opportunity
location: Cole Complex, West Virginia State University
abstract: The inaugural ERS–WVSU seminar introduced a campus-wide forum designed to help researchers from different disciplines sharpen economic questions, strengthen empirical approaches, and explore collaboration. It highlighted the contributions of economic reasoning, data analysis, causal inference, and student research opportunities. The session established a shared vision for sustained research exchange rather than reporting findings from a single study.
